notes: Three isnads to one book, each opened by «رويته»: three groups; the opening clause «ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن المغيرة» names the book's source and is not a link
«محمد بن الحسن» and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men written in succession (rule 7 counter-example): two links
«جدّه» before a name is written as the name alone (rule 7); blessings are left out
